When the fight ends, the mission is over and Leblanc teams her Syndicate up with the Gullwings, who share a goal. You receive the Reassembled Sphere key item. lines: That's for robbing our airship!
You're posing.
I'm posing.
Oh, don't gloat, pet. You'll crease.
Fine. Take it. I'd memorised the good part anyway.
You had the other half. The whole time.
I had the better half, dearie.
Is she flirting with a sphere?
What am I looking at?
The scale is wrong. That's under Bevelle.
Under the temple? Under the whole city?
Built to end a war. Never used. Never scrapped.
Something woke it up.
My crew goes down there. Today.
So does mine.
Then don't slow me down, dearie.
Did we just... team up?
Don't say it out loud.
Someone I am fond of is down there.
That's all you're getting.
She means Noo—
Ormi.
I still hate the pink.
Keep it. It suits you.

dboxTimeline.speaker: Rikku
dboxTimeline.text: Pink. They rob us, and I have to wear pink.

dboxTimeline.speaker: Logos
dboxTimeline.text: You three. Names later. Duties now.

dboxTimeline.speaker: Ormi
dboxTimeline.text: Little one. Terminals. Try not to break them.

dboxTimeline.speaker: Ormi
dboxTimeline.text: Tall one. Stand there and look expensive.

dboxTimeline.speaker: Logos
dboxTimeline.text: And you. The boss wants her shoulders seen to

dboxTimeline.speaker: Rikku
dboxTimeline.text: Best day. This is the best day

dboxTimeline.speaker: Leblanc
dboxTimeline.text: Lower, pet. No. Lower. Do they train you at all?

dboxTimeline.speaker: Leblanc
dboxTimeline.text: Harder. I carry all of Spira on these shoulders.

dboxTimeline.speaker: Logos
dboxTimeline.text: Dining room. Far left door. Check the switch.

dboxTimeline.speaker: Brother
dboxTimeline.text: RIKKU! Rikku, do you copy? It is Brother!

dboxTimeline.speaker: Brother
dboxTimeline.text: I CANNOT HEAR YOU! SPEAK UP!

dboxTimeline.speaker: Brother
dboxTimeline.text: YUNA! Are you massaging the enemy?!

dboxTimeline.speaker: Ormi
dboxTimeline.text: Wait. Wait, wait, wait. I know that voice.

dboxTimeline.speaker: Ormi
dboxTimeline.text: That's — no. No! That's cheating, that is!

dboxTimeline.speaker: Rikku
dboxTimeline.text: He left his door open. Rude, and helpful.

dboxTimeline.speaker: Rikku
dboxTimeline.text: Dud sphere. Dud sphere. Dud— huh.

dboxTimeline.speaker: Rikku
dboxTimeline.text: There! That's ours! That's our half!

dboxTimeline.speaker: Yuna
dboxTimeline.text: Rikku. Look what it is sitting next to.

dboxTimeline.speaker: Paine
dboxTimeline.text: She's had the other half the whole time.

dboxTimeline.speaker: Yuna
dboxTimeline.text: Then we'll ask her for it. Politely.

dboxTimeline.speaker: Leblanc
dboxTimeline.text: Not-So-Mighty Guard, darlings. Do keep up.

dboxTimeline.speaker: Paine
dboxTimeline.text: Three layers. She just doubled this fight.

dboxTimeline.speaker: Rikku
dboxTimeline.text: So we peel them off! Dispel, Dispel!

dboxTimeline.speaker: Leblanc
dboxTimeline.text: You did, lamb. Badly. But you did.

dboxTimeline.speaker: Leblanc
dboxTimeline.text: Well. Nobody left to be clever with.

dboxTimeline.speaker: Rikku
dboxTimeline.text: No more combo! Go, go, go!
